propertySets.name: Pset_AnnotationLineOfSight
propertySets.definition: Specifies the properties of the line of sight. For example, it can be used to define the line of sight visibility at the junction between two roads (particularly between an access road and a public road); or in the design of a stadium or theatre.

properties.name: SetbackDistance
properties.definition: Setback distance from the point of connection on the major element along the axis of the minor element (e.g. distance from a public road at which the line of sigfht is measured.

properties.name: VisibleAngleLeft
properties.definition: Angle of visibility to the left of the access.

properties.name: VisibleAngleRight
properties.definition: Angle of visibility to the right of the access.

properties.name: RoadVisibleDistanceLeft
properties.definition: Distance visible to the left of the access.

properties.name: RoadVisibleDistanceRight
properties.definition: Distance visible to the right of the access.

propertySets.name: Pset_SoundAttenuation
propertySets.definition: Common definition to capture sound pressure at a point on behalf of a device typically used within the context of building services and flow distribution systems.   To indicate sound values from an instance of IfcDistributionFlowElement at a particular location, IfcAnnotation instance(s) should be assigned to the IfcDistributionFlowElement through the IfcRelAssignsToProduct relationship. The IfcAnnotation should specify ObjectType of 'Sound' and geometric representation of 'Annotation Point' consisting of a single IfcPoint subtype as described at IfcAnnotation.  This property set is instantiated multiple times on an object for each frequency band.  HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 2x4.

properties.name: SoundScale
properties.definition:
The reference sound scale.DBA: Decibels in an A-weighted scale
DBB: Decibels in an B-weighted scale
DBC: Decibels in an C-weighted scale
NC: Noise criteria
NR: Noise rating

properties.name: SoundFrequency
properties.definition: List of nominal sound frequencies, correlated to the SoundPressure time series values (IfcTimeSeries.ListValues)

properties.name: SoundPressure
properties.definition: A time series of sound pressure values measured in decibels at a reference pressure of 20 microPascals for the referenced octave band frequency.  Each value in IfcTimeSeries.ListValues is correlated to the sound frequency at the same position within SoundFrequencies.
